name: Butylated hydroxytoluene
aliases: E321, BHT, butylated hydroxytoluene, hidroxitolueno butilado, 2,6-di-tert-butyl-p-cresol
what_is: A synthetic antioxidant used to preserve the freshness and extend the shelf-life of food fats and oils.
why_botia: It flags it due to scientific investigations surrounding its potential endocrine-disrupting properties and hormonal mimetics.
can_1: Detect E321 or BHT on the ingredient label.
can_2: Alert users about its ongoing safety re-evaluations and restrictions in related consumer products.
cannot_1: Determine if the BHT has migrated from the packaging material or was added directly to the food.
cannot_2: Calculate the exact dietary intake of BHT from a single serving of the scanned product.

sources.label: EFSA Scientific Opinion on EAS/ED Substances
